Patient: Ivo Nakamura | DOB: 09/27/1959 | MRN: SYN-2296797
Date of service: 01/04/2025 | Dr. Lucia Ashgrove, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
65-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2023, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: seasonal allergies, hyperlipidemia.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
Inadequate response to methotrexate 20 mg weekly for 25 weeks despite good adherence.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis with high disease activity, CDAI 26.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
